verdict.rationale: Gemini in BigQuery lets users find, join, query and visualize table assets in natural language. It also offers conversational analytics for chatting with data, natural-language queries to start analysis, and data canvas exploration. The core of operating BigQuery via natural-language commands is clearly documented first-party. Missing for 10: evidence that natural language extends beyond analysis and querying to operational and admin tasks (loading data, managing datasets or permissions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the natural-language features work.
